allow: Bash(powershell -Command "cd client; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules; npm install")

Bash(powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_FullName -notlike ''*node_modules*'' -and $_FullName -notlike ''*.git*'' -and $_FullName -notlike ''*dist*'' -and $_FullName -notlike ''*build*'' } | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum | Select-Object Count, @{Name=''SizeMB'';Expression={[math]::Round\($_Sum / 1MB, 2\)}}")
Bash(powershell -Command "Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime")
